thread:
tess: heads-up: saw a short spike where console showed two active sessions for the same client_id across a few eu routes. logs: ```INFO sse: resume_token=true prev_sid=s-aaa new_sid=s-bbb route=eu-west proto=event-stream```
omar: billing ok?
tess: invoicing looks unchanged. only per-route active_session metric doubled for ~90s, alerts fired then resolved.
jo: this smells like resume vs fallback routing mismatch. if resume token hits a shard that doesn't accept it we create a fresh session but telemetry records only new_sid. console thinks it's a new connection.
tess: agreed. quick fixes: 1) emit a low-cardinality metric sse.session_start{outcome} where outcome in [resume, new, fallback]; 2) sample a tiny trace when token present but new session created (include prev_shard, new_shard, client_ip_hash).
omar: +1 but keep tags minimal to avoid cardinality storm. outcome and region only. detailed tenant logs can still include token info for SRE.
jo: UI idea: show a small "resumed" pill when client presented a resume token within 15s of prior session. hover: "Client reattached with resume token. Routing fallback created a new backend session; billing unaffected." Put behind FF to avoid mislabeling NAT cases.
tess: add heuristics: only auto-mark resume if token present AND previous session last_seen < 15s AND token not expired. otherwise show "new".
omar: rollout plan: telemetry only canary 5% tenants, then UI FF for internal tenants, then broader roll. measure false_positive_rate by comparing pill hits vs distinct client_ip_hash.
infra-bot: alert suppressed: sse.dup_conn_spike at 2026-03-25T09:10:12Z
console-bot: ticket created PLAT-9123 "sse resume/fallback telemetry + console badge" assigned tess, omar, jo
pm: will review tooltip copy today. keep wording simple and reassure that billing unaffected.
jo: implement sampling at 0.5%-1% to avoid hot-path cost. logs must be tiny.
tess: I'll open telemetry PR for sse.session_start and a sampled log emitter. jo will do UI badge PR behind FF. omar will adjust alert rule to ignore dup spikes correlated with resume_ratio>0.5 in 1m window.
omar: runbook note: if duplicate sessions persist and resume_ratio low -> escalate to runtime, check recent shard routing changes and proxy upgrade windows.
jo: final note: avoid creating a resume outcome tag on high-cardinality metrics. derive per-route resume_rate in Prometheus from low-cardinality counters.
tess: action items recap: tess -> telem PR + coordinate canary; jo -> console badge + FF; omar -> alert tweak + runbook; pm -> UX copy review. aim for telemetry canary tomorrow 08:00 UTC.
